text:
olivia: quick follow-up on rollout metadata: we need a compact on-path token + richer off-path docs. main goals: tiny headers, tenant overrides, and debuggability.

sam: propose a fixed 16-byte base62 token (TLV inside) for on-path. encodes ref_id, cohort, small flags, checksum. keeps headers stable and tiny.

maria: agree re: small token. telemetry MUST map token -> human ref + schema_ver on control-plane events. otherwise debugging a misparse is painful.

dinesh: runtime constraint: never parse full doc on hot path. SDKs => cache token->doc async; runtime consults local resolver, synchronous miss -> use fallback list.

kevin: ops: tenants need pinning without changing global refs. propose precedence: tenant_anchor > rollout_ref > default_ref. anchors must carry expiry and operator justification.

anjali: SDK UX: add SDK.onPinOverride hook so apps can warn or log when tenant anchors apply. also allow `honor_tenant_anchors: true|false` in SDK config for opt-out.

sam: TLV layout sketch: 4B ref_hash, 4B cohort_id, 2B flags, 2B version, 4B checksum. reserve high bits for future. sample encoder will be small.

maria: telemetry fields to emit: token, resolved_ref, schema_version, anchor_id (if applied), anchor_source. include these as span attributes.

dinesh: runtime probe: `/v1/pin-info?tenant=...` returns minimal JSON: token, resolved_ref, effective_fallbacks[], applied_anchor_id. rate-limited. good for on-call debugging.

kevin: anchor doc (off-path) example (stored in control plane):
```json
{
  "anchor_id": "anch-2026-04-09-42",
  "tenant": "acme-corp",
  "pinned_ref": "model-v3.1",
  "expires_at": "2026-07-01T00:00:00Z",
  "reason": "payment-related rollback",
  "grace_window_seconds": 600
}
```

sam: small safety: anchors should include max_renewals or require manual approval on renew to avoid infinite pins. also TTL for token caches: control-plane changes must create new token ids to avoid mid-rollout invalidation.

maria: QA: add tests for anchor expiry, anchor injection, and telemetry correlate runs. also test SDK opt-out path.

od: pin-bot: :pushpin: Anchor created: anch-2026-04-09-42 for tenant acme-corp (expires 2026-07-01T00:00:00Z).

olivia: next steps: sam -> TLV encoder prototype; dinesh -> probe spec + cache eviction policy (LRU + pinned); maria -> telemetry mapping doc; kevin -> ops runbook and alerts. i'll open a PR with schemas tomorrow.

kevin: i'll add dashboards/alerts for unresolved tokens > 1h and anchor expiry notifications.

sam: will prototype encoder today.

dinesh: will stub probe endpoint and document rate limits.

maria: will outline telemetry events and span attributes.

olivia: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
